system.description:
Requirements: Training (2) and Expertise (2) in Melee Weapons or Ranged Weapons, and you must receive training from a practitioner of this style, or have access to its teachings

Zephyr Style teaches that a fight belongs to whoever refuses to be caught in it. The practitioner keeps moving, strikes from where the enemy was not looking, and is gone before the answer comes; every step is a working of the air, and every loosed arrow rides a wind that knows the way. Zephyr Style rules the open ground and the space between engagements — harrying, slipping, denying the enemy the blow it wanted.

You move like the wind, ever in motion, and never held.

As an Action, you may enter Zephyr Style.

  • The height and distance of your Jump is doubled.

  • You ignore Difficult Terrain.

  • Your maximum Focus is 3. When you enter Zephyr Style, you gain +1 Focus.

  • Build Focus: Once per turn, you may use an Action to gain +1 Focus.

  • Channel the Wind: At the end of your turn, you gain +1 Focus for each of the following:

    • You used the Dodge action.

    • You attacked with a Melee or Ranged Weapon AND you ended your turn at least 2 Spaces away from where you were when your turn began.

  • When you make an Attack Check with a Melee or Ranged weapon you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling to gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

  • If you did not spend or gain any Focus during your turn, Zephyr Style immediately ends. Focus spent between turns is NOT counted for this purpose.

  • If you have 0 Focus at the end of your turn, Zephyr Style immediately ends.

  • If you enter another Stance, Zephyr Style immediately ends.

If you choose, you may begin maintaining Zephyr Style before combat starts, at the cost of giving up your first Action on your first turn in combat.
